title: Be registered as a bookmaker
what: Engage in bookmaking only as a registered bookmaker (and bookmakers' agents only while registered, s 133).

sources.title: Racing Regulation and Integrity Act 2024 (Tas)
sources.quote: A person must not engage in bookmaking on the person’s own behalf unless the person is registered as a bookmaker
